venues.name: Les Enfants Brillants
venues.address: Carrer de Guàrdia 3, 08002 Barcelona
venues.notes: Intimate club in the heart of El Raval. Known for underground electronic music.

venues.name: Studio Stereo
venues.address: Rambla de Catalunya 23, 08007 Barcelona
venues.notes: Audiophile social club and listening room in the Eixample. Hi-Fi sound system, vinyl turntables, rotary mixers and terraces.

venues.name: Input High Fidelity
venues.address: Av. de Francesc Ferrer i Guàrdia 13, 08038 Barcelona · Poble Espanyol
venues.notes: High-fidelity dance club inside Poble Espanyol. Funktion-One sound and immersive visuals, focused on headsy house and techno.

venues.name: Nitsa (Sala Apolo)
venues.address: Carrer Nou de la Rambla 113, 08004 Barcelona
venues.notes: Temple of electronic music inside Sala Apolo since 1996. Raw, sweaty atmosphere with legendary international bookings.

venues.name: Moog Club
venues.address: Carrer de l'Arc del Teatre 3, 08001 Barcelona
venues.notes: Iconic Raval club open since 1996 in the former Villa Rosa tablao. Resident DJs keep the essence of local techno and house alive.

venues.name: Garage of The Bass Valley
venues.address: Passatge Can Polític 13, 08907 L'Hospitalet de Llobregat
venues.notes: Warehouse-turned-club by The Bass Valley academy. One of the best sounding dance floors in the greater Barcelona area.

venues.name: Razzmatazz
venues.address: Carrer dels Almogàvers 122, 08018 Barcelona · Poblenou
venues.notes: Barcelona's cathedral of nightlife since 1995, inside two former factories in Poblenou. RazzClub, Human and Torax nights spin house, techno, acid and electro for a proudly mixed crowd.

venues.name: Jamboree
venues.address: Plaça Reial 17, 08002 Barcelona · El Gòtic
venues.notes: Historic jazz hall since 1960 that turns into a cellar dancefloor at night — vinyl-true funk, afro, soul and disco under Plaça Reial. Jazz and jam sessions before midnight.

venues.name: Marula Café
venues.address: Carrer dels Escudellers 49, 08002 Barcelona · El Gòtic
venues.notes: The temple of groove in the Gòtic — vinyl DJs spinning funk, disco, soul, afrobeat and Latin sounds to a dancefloor that never sits still. Jam sessions midweek, club nights at the weekend.

venues.name: La Terrrazza
venues.address: Av. Francesc Ferrer i Guàrdia 13, 08038 Barcelona · Poble Espanyol
venues.notes: Open-air electronic club inside Poble Espanyol since 1995, running May to November. House, trance and progressive under the stars on a Balearic-style terrace.

venues.name: Sala Upload
venues.address: Av. Francesc Ferrer i Guàrdia 13, 08038 Barcelona · Poble Espanyol
venues.notes: Sala Upload hosts the Barcelona Underground parties and the Picnic Beat cycle inside Poble Espanyol — a platform for local and international electronic talent.

venues.name: BORIS
venues.address: Carrer de Bori i Fontestà 25, 08021 Barcelona · Sarrià-Sant Gervasi
venues.notes: Discreet uptown club in Sarrià-Sant Gervasi, hidden in plain sight. Exclusive electronic nights with a polished, intimate atmosphere.

venues.name: Yuyu
venues.address: Dr. Carmona y Valle 135, Col. Doctores, Cuauhtémoc, CDMX
venues.notes: Iconic underground club, reborn in September 2025 in an ex-casino in the Doctores. Now includes a cinema, bar and Martin Audio sound.

venues.name: Fünk
venues.address: Av. Insurgentes Sur 377, Hipódromo Condesa, CDMX
venues.notes: Basement dance club on the edge of Roma and Hipódromo, focused on acoustic fidelity. Vinyl selectors and Funktion One sound.

venues.name: Drama Radio
venues.address: Querétaro 188, Roma Norte, CDMX
venues.notes: Multifaceted space born in 2023: independent radio, bar, cinema, record store and café in one. A community hub for music.

venues.name: Departamento
venues.address: Av. Álvaro Obregón 154 (primer piso), Roma Norte, CDMX
venues.notes: Multi-level Roma Norte space with a sprawling terrace. Rotating floors mixing techno, disco and funk in an intimate setting.

venues.name: LooLoo Studio
venues.address: Londres 195, Col. Juárez, CDMX
venues.notes: Hidden behind a neutral Juárez facade. The 'Studio' room is all LED panels and riffs on deep house and techno with high-profile guests.

venues.name: Sunday Sunday
venues.address: Tabaqueros 16, Centro Histórico, CDMX
venues.notes: Multi-level Centro venue with a speakeasy area and a rooftop overlooking the city. Sunday house sessions with an international crowd.

venues.name: Bar Oriente
venues.address: Calle Durango 181, Roma Norte, 06700 CDMX
venues.notes: Three-room club in Roma with a heavy system that hits right — techno all week long, a small sweaty dancefloor and a smoking courtyard out back.

venues.name: Phonique
venues.address: Av. Paseo de las Palmas 555, Lomas de Chapultepec, CDMX
venues.notes: Exclusive house club in Lomas de Chapultepec dedicated to afro house, latin house, nu disco and disco — upscale, polished and dance-first.

venues.name: Musak
venues.address: Calle Tonalá 171, Roma Norte, CDMX
venues.notes: Multi-level Hi-Fi listening bar in Roma — audiophiles nursing mezcal cocktails while vinyl spins on museum-quality equipment. The music programming turns serious after 9pm.

venues.name: Kinshasa
venues.address: Av. Querétaro 225, Roma Norte, CDMX
venues.notes: Rooftop named after Congo's capital where afro house meets mezcalitas. A Mediterranean-African dinner spot that turns into a dancefloor once the sun goes down.

venues.name: Balmori Roofbar
venues.address: Calle Zacatecas 139 (2º piso), Roma Norte, 06700 CDMX
venues.notes: Rooftop in Roma with a retractable roof and unrivalled views over the tree-lined streets. DJ sets Wednesday to Friday, disco ball after dark.

venues.name: Japan
venues.address: Calle Uruapan 20, Roma Norte, 06700 CDMX
venues.notes: Multi-room club in Roma Norte with a high-fidelity, acoustically treated main room and an underground European-and-Japanese aesthetic. Dries no Coca-Cola — only Boing, and famously tiered entry pricing.
